opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers into Forsage through a direct-message registration route and ties entry to a 0.05 ETH payment: “Crypto Currency Ethereum Forsage Smart Contract for registration DM [PHONE](4)” and “When you register in Forsage with 0.05 ETH you open both programs simultaneously” [citation]. It then presents progressively more expensive slots as producing progressively greater returns, stating, “Each subsequent slot you purchase is two times the value of the previous one and it generates twice the income as well” [citation]. The branching X3 and X4 diagrams and ETH-denominated slot grids make that tiered structure visible [citation]. Participation is framed around earning and withdrawing money, while the narration says, “You'll definitely need to fill in the blank in order to earn” [citation].
